如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    九州大陆，修武一途，境界分别为：
灵武，元武，玄武，天武四大境界，每个境界又分九重。
楚枫于五年前拜入青龙宗，开始修武。
他修炼到灵武二重，只用了短短一个月的时间。
可灵武三重，却用了足足五年，也未能突破。
之所以如此，乃是因为当初的一场变故。
五年前，九州大陆上空，出现九色神雷，楚枫更是被雷霆劈中。
从那日起，楚枫的丹田之内，就出现了九只雷霆巨兽。
楚枫能在短时间，踏入灵武二重，正是拜神雷所赐。
可成也神雷，败也神雷。
到了灵武二重后，神雷开始吞噬楚枫体内灵气。
无法聚灵，便无法突破。
这就是楚枫，迟迟无法踏入灵武三重的原因。
不过，楚枫发现，只要将这九只雷霆巨兽喂饱，自己的修为便能突破。
经过五年积累，楚枫距离突破，只差一线。
楚枫猛然睁开双眼，眼中竟有丝丝雷光，一种无法言语的喜悦之情，挂在了脸上。
“成功了，足足五年，我楚枫终于成功了。”楚枫狂喜无比。
虽如他所料，只要将九只雷霆巨兽喂饱，就能突破。
但当这一日真的来临，楚枫还是难以控制自己的情绪。
因为这一天，足足迟到了五年。

“这种感觉好强，源源不断的灵气，正在体内奔腾，仿佛要破体而出一般。”
仔细观察身体，楚枫更加兴奋，他想不到神雷竟会直接凝聚成丹，盘踞于丹田之内，并且神雷所散发出的灵气，非常浓郁，简直超乎想象。
他知道，就算是他这五年，不眠不休的修炼，也不可能凝聚出，如此强大的灵气，而之所以会如此，正是因为那神雷。
可就在这时，楚枫的身体突然一僵，神情也是大变。
神雷正在变化，他的力量瞬间增长数倍，竟然再次突破，踏入了灵武四重。
“苦尽甘来么？”
楚枫握紧拳头，感受着体内那爆炸性的力量，他觉得这五年来吃得苦都值了。
“父亲，从今日开始，我不再是你的累赘，我将成为您的骄傲。”
楚枫激动不已，对未来更是充满期待。
他不是楚家人，而是楚家老五楚渊收养的义子。
楚家排外，大部分家人，都不认可楚枫，楚枫从小到大，遭受欺凌，只有楚月会时不时帮助他。
若不是其义父极力维护，楚枫早就被赶出家门。
可当楚枫拜入青龙宗，却迟迟无法踏入内门后，就连其义父楚渊，在楚家也是抬不起头。
但楚枫知道，这一切，很快都将结束。
在这以武为尊的世界，实力大于一切。
只要他能变强，便没有任何人，敢瞧不起他。
青龙宗招收弟子，每年只有一次，每次持续十日。
十日之后，每年一次的内门考核也将开始，而这一次，沉寂了五年的楚枫，终于能参加了。
考核地点，是一座庞大的地宫，地宫的大殿之内人山人海，足有上万人。
这些人大多是灵武三重，因为所有人都知道，内门考核至少要灵武三重才能通过。

不过却有部分灵武二重的弟子，想来浑水摸鱼，这样的人每年都有，但大多都以失败告终。
值得一提的是，还有一小部分人是灵武四重，他们可不是修炼迟钝的庸才，相反有些人还是天才。
他们是故意在灵武四重之时，才选择参加内门考核，至于原因，那就是为了奖赏。
灵武三重，已是可以修炼武技。
武技是一种强大的攻击手段，不仅能够将实力发挥的淋漓尽致，更是能够获得超越人体极限的力量。
正因如此，武技非常珍贵，连豪门世家也是没有，这也是为何各大世家，也要将后人送入宗门培养的原因。
因为每个宗门内，都拥有大量的武技，而在这青龙宗，只要成为内门弟子，便可以修炼武技。
只不过，武技也有品阶之分，从弱到强共分为九段。
在内门之中，可以修炼到最好的，也只是三段武技。
但每年一次的内门考核中，第一个通过考核者，却可以拿到一本四段武技。
所以有些人，之所以宁愿在外门修炼，也不肯进入内门，为的就是那本四段武技。
“快看，那不是杨天雨么？”
“真的是他，年仅十三岁，就已达到灵武四重，看来这次考核的第一，非他莫属。”
人海之中，一名稚嫩的少年引起了人们的注意。
外门弟子足有数十万，大多数是默默无闻的角色，但有些人却是关注的焦点，这种人多半是天才，而这杨天雨便是其中之一。

There are four realms: Lingwu, Yuanwu, Xuanwu, and Tianwu. Each realm is divided into nine levels.
Chu Feng joined the Qinglong Sect five years ago and began to practice martial arts.
It only took him a short month to reach the second level of Lingwu.
But it took five years to reach the third level of Lingwu, but he still couldn't break through.
The reason for this is because of an accident at the beginning.
Five years ago, nine-color divine thunder appeared in the sky over the Jiuzhou Continent, and Chu Feng was struck by the thunder.
From that day on, nine thunder beasts appeared in Chu Feng's dantian.
Chu Feng was able to step into the second level of Lingwu in a short period of time because of the gift of Divine Thunder.
Success is also a divine thunder, failure is also a divine thunder.
After reaching the second level of Lingwu, the divine thunder began to swallow up the spiritual energy in Chu Feng's body.
If you can't gather your soul, you can't break through.
This is the reason why Chu Feng has been unable to enter the third level of Lingwu.
However, Chu Feng discovered that as long as he fed these nine thunder beasts, his cultivation level would be able to break through.
After five years of accumulation, Chu Feng was only one step away from a breakthrough.
Chu Feng suddenly opened his eyes, and there was a trace of lightning in his eyes, and an indescribable joy hung on his face.
"Successful. After five years, I, Chu Feng, finally succeeded." Chu Feng was extremely happy.
Although as he expected, he could break through as long as he fed the nine thunder beasts.
But when this day really came, Chu Feng still found it difficult to control his emotions.
Because this day is five years late.
"This feeling is so strong, a steady stream of spiritual energy is rushing through the body, as if it is about to burst out of the body."
Observing the body carefully, Chu Feng became even more excited. He did not expect that the divine thunder would directly condense into a pill and occupy the dantian. Moreover, the spiritual energy emitted by the divine thunder was very rich and beyond imagination.
He knew that even if he had practiced non-stop for the past five years, he would not be able to condense such a powerful spiritual energy, and the reason for this was precisely because of the divine thunder.
But at this moment, Chu Feng's body suddenly stiffened, and his expression changed drastically.
The divine thunder was changing, and his power increased several times in an instant, and he broke through again and entered the fourth level of spiritual martial arts.
"After all the hardship comes happiness?"
Chu Feng clenched his fists and felt the explosive power in his body. He felt that all the hardships he had endured in the past five years were worth it.
"Father, from today on, I will no longer be a burden to you, I will become your pride."
Chu Feng was very excited and full of expectations for the future.
He is not the Chu family, but the adopted son of Chu Yuan, the fifth eldest son of the Chu family.
The Chu family is xenophobic, and most of the family members do not recognize Chu Feng. Chu Feng has been bullied since he was a child, and only Chu Yue will help him from time to time.
If it weren't for his adoptive father's strong protection, Chu Feng would have been kicked out of the house long ago.
But when Chu Feng worshiped the Qinglong Sect, but was still unable to step into the inner gate, even his adoptive father Chu Yuan could not raise his head in the Chu family.
But Chu Feng knew that all this would soon end.
In this world where martial arts is respected, strength is greater than anything else.
As long as he can become stronger, no one will dare to look down on him.
Qinglong Sect recruits disciples only once a year, and each session lasts for ten days.
Ten days later, the annual inner sect assessment will also begin, and this time, Chu Feng, who has been silent for five years, can finally participate.
The assessment location is a huge underground palace. The main hall of the underground palace is crowded with tens of thousands of people.
Most of these people are at the third level of Lingwu, because everyone knows that the inner sect examination requires at least the third level of Lingwu to pass.
However, there are some disciples of the second level of Lingwu who want to fish in troubled waters. There are such people every year, but most of them end in failure.
It is worth mentioning that there are still a small number of people who are at the fourth level of spiritual martial arts. They are not mediocre people who are slow in cultivation. On the contrary, some of them are geniuses.
They deliberately chose to participate when they were at the fourth level of Lingwu.As for the reason for adding the inner sect assessment, it is for rewards.
At the third level of spiritual martial arts, one can already practice martial arts.
Martial arts is a powerful means of attack, which not only allows you to fully demonstrate your strength, but also allows you to gain power beyond the limits of the human body.
Because of this, martial arts are very precious, even among wealthy families. This is why major families send their descendants to sects for training.
Because every sect has a large number of martial arts, and in the Qinglong Sect, as long as you become an inner disciple, you can practice martial arts.
However, martial arts also have grades, which are divided into nine levels from weak to strong.
Among the inner sect, the best that can be cultivated is the third level of martial arts.
But in the annual inner sect examination, the first person to pass the examination can get a copy of the fourth-level martial arts.
Therefore, the reason why some people would rather practice in the outer sect than enter the inner sect is because of the four-stage martial arts.
"Look, isn't that Yang Tianyu?"
"It's really him. He is only thirteen years old and has already reached the fourth level of Lingwu. It seems that he must be the first in this assessment."
Among the crowd, a young boy caught people's attention.
There are hundreds of thousands of outer disciples, most of them are unknown characters, but some people are the center of attention. Most of these people are geniuses, and Yang Tianyu is one of them.
